statements.t: From time to time, the Company also enters into longer-term contracts, including to fulfill large complex laundry projects for divisions of the federal government, where the nature of, and competition for, such contracts may result in a lower gross margin as compared to other equipment sales.

However, the Company faces risks relating to inflation and other price increases (including due to tariffs), including that there is no assurance that the Company will be able to effectively increase the price of its products and services to offset increased costs and any such increase may have an adverse impact on the market for the Company’s products and services.

statements.t: As EVI grows, management expects those investments to be leveraged across a larger revenue base, while continued operating improvements provide an additional path to margin expansion.
As those capabilities are adopted across a growing enterprise, management expects them to support further productivity gains, new customer relationships and repeat business.
The Company intends to develop this business deliberately.

Results in the division’s first month also reflected seasonal patterns in the business and investments EVI is making in back-office personnel and support functions to prepare for future acquisitions, and management expects these investments to be absorbed over time as the division scales.

Management believes the essential nature of the products and services EVI provides, its relationships with established manufacturers and its broad customer base will continue to support the business over time, while acknowledging that cost pressures and project timing may affect results in individual periods.
We will continue to invest with discipline, improve the experience we provide to customers and pursue acquisitions when we believe they can create value.

dropped.t: Both deliveries and installations depend on customer facility readiness and construction schedules, and both can be delayed by events outside of the Company’s control, including adverse weather conditions, as certain projects were in the third quarter of fiscal 2026.

Modernization of the Company’s operations is an ongoing program, not a completed project, and management believes EVI’s performance will continue to improve as it advances — producing meaningful and sustained operating leverage over time.

As sales grow, operations are further refined, and utilization of these technologies deepens across the enterprise, management expects a greater portion of incremental gross profit to flow through to earnings.

We believe that this approach has earned us a reputation as the acquirer of choice in the commercial laundry industry, with owners of target companies excited to become part of a value-driven company with a strong track record, a growth-oriented culture, and a deep commitment to customer satisfaction.
We expect that this reputation will continue to open doors and fuel our long-term buy-and-build strategy. ”
